The main takeaway from our work is that
the e-CRM concept is not only relevant to large firms and that SMEs can also benefit from the adoption of e-CRM.

SMEs can use e-CRM to facilitate the development and management of customer relationships, but that this is contingent upon a clear understanding of the SME context and a recognition that e-CRM can be adapted to suit the unique SME business and marketing environment.
